segments.name: wafer fabrication
segments.description: Fabricates wafers, chips and integrated circuits to customers' design specifications using its own proprietary process technologies for fabless design companies and integrated device manufacturers.
segments.evidence: The Company only has wafer fabrication operating segment as the single reporting segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the company to manufacture wafers, chips and integrated circuits to their own design specifications at its semiconductor foundries.
revenueModel.evidence: Using our own proprietary processes and techniques, we make chips to the design specifications of our many customers.

changes.text: In 2024 the company completed the disposal of its ownership in UnitedDS Semiconductor (Shandong) Co., Ltd. as part of its strategic plan.
changes.evidence: The disposal was completed in August 2024 with a total transaction price of RMB¥77 million, which was approximately NT$341 million.
